scripts.build:server: node node_modules/esbuild/bin/esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=server.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('server/dist', {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('server.js', 'server/dist/index.js');"
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.test: node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs --test server/test/timezone.test.ts server/test/stateMachine.test.ts server/test/metaErrors.test.ts server/test/tokenVault.test.ts server/test/idempotency.test.ts
